items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And we had Allen in the band, who was sort of like a legendary character to me.

ctx.x: Yeah, some of the girls up there would help them relax. And knowing Raymond Scott, that's the most unlikely guy in the world to ever say it to.

But you know, those days there were so many musicians in New York. I think it was 1940, after Benny got out of the hospital he reorganized the sextet. And we had Allen in the band, who was sort of like a legendary character to me. And he

was very nice to me, invited me up to his home. You know, we had a good chicken dinner. He asked me what I liked and I told him I liked fried chicken, I didn't mean anything by it. Later years I learned that some people are sensitive about that. But that happened to be what I liked.
